snippet.title: DEAD LAMB WALKING | RPG Maker Horror | No Commentary
snippet.description:
Please heed the content warnings listed at the beginning if you might have any triggers. There's some stuff in there........

Game: DEAD LAMB WALKING
Find the game here: https://rambamboo.itch.io/dead-lamb-walking
Original creator: Lyn Mametchi
Release Date: 2024
Engine: RPG Maker MV
I do NOT own anything on this video, all credit to their respective creators.

If the creator wants me to take this down, please tell me.
もしクリエイターがこれを削除することを望むなら、私に言ってほしい。 (DeepL)


A rare upload from me in the current year. Shocking, I know. I blame a certain popular little indie game that came out with 2 chapters last June. Anyway.

I had found this game around the time it came out on Bluesky, but only now I got around to it, because it's either my executive function, refusal to close my 5000 tabs, or procrastination. Your pick.

But hoo boy, what a story this was. It was heavy and did actually make me feel dread. A lot of it. But in a good way. It's heavy, but I think it did a good job with it. I thought the story was good, even if I did find the ending to be dragging at points, but that's more of a personal preference.

The art is really nice, and I really liked how the palette changed between scenes. Love me some limited color palettes.

There isn't really gameplay aside from a few brief walking scenes and some ending choices, but I don't really mind that. I wonder if picking your other friends in the ending would've changed something, but eh. I sort of doubt it.

......Man, that twist though. I sort of suspected something was off, but like man. My dread went from 10 to 100 real quick with the reveal. And like, I wish more consequences were at play for a certain someone, but like... Usually, there isn't. But man...


Anyway, I did enjoy my time with this. If you liked the game, consider supporting it in some way. (There's a soundtrack you can buy and also an artbook so perhaps check those out.)


.....Also I GUESS thanks for 1000 subs. I didn't expect that to ever happen and especially in the midst of my upload drought. Sort of late to it but thank you all. Feels weird to say especially now since I got a 1000 in May. Whoops.
